resources.string: Anything you save leaves this app\'s private storage. Erasing app data later cannot remove a file you have already saved.
A summary of what an APK check found. Save the redacted version to share with someone else, or the technical version to keep full detail.
An app\'s decoded AndroidManifest.xml, saved as readable text.
Save an installed app\'s package files or its icon. Split packages are saved as a set and are not guaranteed to reinstall.
A redacted list of the connections seen while monitoring. Endpoint addresses, DNS values and app identifiers are left out.
A PCAPNG recording for tools like Wireshark. This one can contain addresses and unencrypted content, so treat the saved file as sensitive.
Your rules and preferences, so you can move them to another device. Keys, consents and captured data are never included.
